solution: Convert Retro Game Center's fraction to a percentage. First, convert $\frac{3}{12}$ to a decimal: $3 \div 12 = 0.250$
Then convert the decimal to a percentage by multiplying by 100: $0.250 \times 100 = 25.0$%, so approximately 25%
Compare the percentages: Gaming Arcade Plus had 55% and Retro Game Center had approximately 25%.
Since 55% > 25%, Retro Game Center had all machines occupied on a greater percentage of nights.
